summary: COSE (RFC 9052) provides signing and encryption for CBOR data. This document specifies how to use the AES counter (CTR) and cipher block chaining (CBC) modes as content encryption algorithms in COSE. Because these modes do not authenticate data on their own, they need care when used.

eli5.summary: This is a recipe for scrambling small data packages using two well-known mixing methods, so only someone with the key can unscramble them.
